concepts.name: Single-Family
concepts.summary: Detached homes on both new tiers.

streets.section: ST-02 60' local road: 2' + 5' walk + 2.5' C&G + 41' asphalt + 2.5' C&G + 5' walk + 2'

notes: Harvest Lane south of Jasper (dedicated on the Phase 1 plat) and Lots 116-118 are carried in the South Parcel proforma and removed from the main Delta Crossings proforma.
Jasper Drive (incl. its south curb, gutter and walk) is treated as built by Phase 1.
ditchPipeLf is only needed if the double line shown in Parcel C on the preliminary plat is a live ditch.

stormwater.note: Parcel A already receives the Phase 1 30" storm drain. This volume is the extra storage for the south parcel, spread over Parcel A plus the new open space (70% of area as basin floor).

compliance.label: Zoning
compliance.requirement: Parcel is inside the 49.055-ac M-H to R-4 rezone
compliance.detail: R-4 per Ord. 23-300 (effective 2023-04-19)

compliance.label: Allowed uses
compliance.requirement: R-4 allows SF, two-, three-, four-family and townhomes; max 4 units/building
compliance.detail: Largest building: 1 units

compliance.label: SF lot area
compliance.requirement: 7,500 SF minimum
compliance.detail: Smallest SF lot 7,713 SF

compliance.label: Townhome building lot area
compliance.requirement: 7,500 SF + 2,000 SF per unit after the first
compliance.detail: No townhomes in this concept

compliance.label: Lot frontage
compliance.requirement: 70' minimum, 75' corner; townhomes measured across the building
compliance.detail: Narrowest new frontage 77.9'

compliance.label: Setbacks
compliance.requirement: Front 25', side 10', rear 10', corner street side 20'
compliance.detail: Every footprint inside its setback envelope

compliance.label: Height
compliance.requirement: 35' maximum
compliance.detail: SF 1-2 story; townhomes 2 story (~28')

compliance.label: Parking
compliance.requirement: 3 side-by-side 9x18 stalls per unit; no tandem; garage or driveway, not both
compliance.detail: 3 driveway stalls per unit; garages not counted

compliance.label: Townhome parking
compliance.requirement: Stalls on the unit's own lot, fronting the ROW, not shared
compliance.detail: No townhomes in this concept

compliance.label: Townhome open space
compliance.requirement: 500 SF private open space per unit on its own lot
compliance.detail: No townhomes in this concept

compliance.label: Townhome frontage and walks
compliance.requirement: Every building fronts a public street; 4' walk from each unit to the ROW
compliance.detail: No townhomes in this concept

compliance.label: One principal structure per lot
compliance.requirement: Each building on its own lot; units on their own unit lots
compliance.detail: One building per lot; townhome units on unit lots

compliance.label: Street section
compliance.requirement: 60' ROW; 41' asphalt, 2.5' curb and gutter, 5' walks both sides
compliance.detail: Street A/B: 60' ROW, ST-02 section

compliance.label: Street pattern
compliance.requirement: No alleys, cul-de-sacs or permanent dead ends
compliance.detail: Street A/B loops Harvest Lane to Jasper Drive

compliance.label: Block length
compliance.requirement: 330'-630' centerline to centerline
compliance.detail: Harvest to Street B: 507'

compliance.label: Lot access
compliance.requirement: Every lot abuts a 60' public street; side lines square to the street
compliance.detail: All lots front Harvest Lane or Street A

compliance.label: Jasper Drive frontage
compliance.requirement: No driveways on Jasper (450 North major collector); 10' rear planting buffer
compliance.detail: North-tier lots back onto Jasper with a 10' rear buffer; needs LUA approval as double-frontage lots

compliance.label: Intersections
compliance.requirement: Streets meet at 90° and line up with existing intersections
compliance.detail: Street A leaves Harvest at 90°; Street B lines up with Emerald Way (4-way)

compliance.label: Storm drainage
compliance.requirement: Hold the 24-hour, 10-year storm on site (NOAA Atlas 14: 1.37 in)
compliance.detail: 10,332 CF (0.24 ac-ft) extra storage; about 3.4 in. over the basin

compliance.label: Ditches
compliance.requirement: No open ditches within or adjoining the subdivision
compliance.detail: Pipe the Parcel C ditch if it is live (about 225 LF)

compliance.label: Utility easements
compliance.requirement: 15' total easement width; 10' PUE along lot fronts
compliance.detail: 10' front PUE inside the 25' setback; 7.5' rear/side easements as needed
